_comment: Committed host paths for the Vast A100-80GB PCIe box (D-609). Values are FILESYSTEM LOCATIONS, never design. Boot fails closed if any path is absent. NOTE: /dev/shm is mounted noexec on this container, so the CUDA helper .so lives on the root filesystem -- a shared object under /dev/shm cannot be mmap'd PROT_EXEC and the server dies at load.
